title: Residential Natural Gas Supply Plan Schedule — Pricing Structure, Term and Rate-Change Notice
content:
Residential Natural Gas Supply is sold on seven plans. Each plan has one pricing structure — variable, capped variable or fixed — and a term stated in whole months, where a term of 0 months means month-to-month service with no end date.

## Pricing structure and term

| Plan | Pricing structure | Term (months) | Introductory cycles billed at the enrollment rate | Billed rate may never exceed the enrollment rate (rate ceiling) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Gas Monthly Variable | variable | 0 (month-to-month) | 1 | No |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Capped Variable 12 | capped variable | 12 | 0 (none) | Yes |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 12 | fixed | 12 | 0 (none) | No |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 24 | fixed | 24 | 0 (none) | No |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 36 | fixed | 36 | 0 (none) | No |
| Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 12 | fixed | 12 | 0 (none) | No |
| Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 24 | fixed | 24 | 0 (none) | No |

The introductory-cycle figure is the number of initial billing cycles billed at the enrollment rate before monthly variable pricing applies. The rate ceiling, where it applies, means the rate billed in any cycle of the term may never exceed the enrollment rate.

## Rate-change notice terms

| Plan | Variable rate notice period: minimum notice for a variable rate change (calendar days before its effective date) | Cycles a new variable rate applies to | Regulatory pass-through allowed during the term | Regulatory change notice period: minimum notice for a regulatory pass-through (calendar days before its effective date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Gas Monthly Variable | 10 | cycles beginning on or after the effective date | No | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Capped Variable 12 | 10 | cycles beginning on or after the effective date | Yes | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 12 | 10 | cycles beginning on or after the effective date | Yes | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 24 | 10 | cycles beginning on or after the effective date | Yes | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 36 | 10 | cycles beginning on or after the effective date | No | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 12 | 10 | cycles beginning on or after the effective date | Yes | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 24 | 10 | cycles beginning on or after the effective date | No | 30 |

"Regulatory pass-through allowed" states whether a fixed or capped rate may be adjusted during the term to pass through a change in law or regulation.

## Reading the schedule

- **Which plans are fixed?** Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 12, 24 and 36 and Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 12 and 24 carry the fixed pricing structure.
- **Which plan carries a term of 0 months?** Only Beacon Ridge Gas Monthly Variable; it is also the only plan with an introductory cycle billed at the enrollment rate.
- **Which plans may pass through a regulatory change during the term?** Beacon Ridge Gas Capped Variable 12, Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 12, Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 24 and Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 12. Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 36, Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 24 and Beacon Ridge Gas Monthly Variable carry "No".
